sprint.title: Sprint 195 — Visualization breadth and certification: every chart identity classified, certified or typed, rendered in every declared theme, placeable, and bitten
sprint.focus: Derek's go 2026-09-11 after the Sprint 194 review ("yes, confirmed. proceed with s195 planning … proceed with increment 14"). Increment 14 = phase-map milestone M4 (#1893): a versioned taxonomy and Core Analytics Profile over the 13 registered chart types and the 21 pattern specs (34/34 classified; core cells surface-complete or typed gaps; financial and scientific typed); the 21 patterns promoted to recipe identities with public pixel proof through a viz.render `pattern` input; the ECharts certification architecture decided as the declared operand profile (a11y pillar graded, conformant folded, bubble_map/flow_map accuracy rules, force_graph decided) so 13/13 types are certified or typed-uncertified with a pinned reason; the Role-A hue revision (≥10 ΔE00 over CVD with Role-C ≥3:1) as a declared palette mover; high-contrast pixels as the HC scope's CSS system-colour keywords verified under forced-colours emulation, theme hc admitted on viz.render/dashboard.render/artifact.certify; charts placeable beyond area through a general Mark*-trait placement rule (bar, line and one ECharts family placed; the rest typed not-placed); three viz mutation bites; #1442 soak bounded. Base = certified Sprint 194 head 5b25c3c9 (public implementation 71538162; PR #100 draft) merged with origin/OODS-pro 3872feaf → c36eadc5. Measured at the base: registry 13 rows (5 vega-lite certified / 8 echarts uncertified), themes light/dark only (hc:false ×13), contrastPassed light+dark for 9 and [] for 4 exempt, accuracy rules 0 for force_graph/bubble_map/flow_map, chartInApp placed for area only, dashboardDrawn 11 (chord/flow_map excluded #881); no taxonomy; 21 pattern specs in examples/viz/patterns-v2 with no public pixel path; Role-A 9.8774 light / 9.9513 dark; health.productReality serves runtime and tools only; no viz bite. Seven serial missions: m01 deliver 5b25c3c9 (or the PR #100 merge) + send the three prepared notices + widen the retirement gate · m02 taxonomy + Core Analytics Profile generated and served · m03 patterns promoted with proof · m04 ECharts operand certification profile · m05 Role-A revision + HC pixels · m06 placement + bites + soak · m07 closeout. Settled decisions, movers, descope ladder and never-cut line in cmos/planning/forge-s195-visualization-breadth-decision-memo.md; handoff cmos/planning/forge-s195-build-handoff.md. Worktree ~/.codex/worktrees/s195/OODS-Forge, branch codex/sprint-195-visualization-breadth. Sprint 194 rules in force: no inert options, generated registries, boundary specs for every schema change, ledger 19/19 product-reality, one capture under #1833, pace rule, builderSelfCertified:false. Carries placed: #1935 portable limits → Sprint 196; #1915 craft → the craft pass after M5; #1438 → Derek.

missions.name: Charts placeable beyond area through a general placement rule, three viz mutation bites, the soak bounded
missions.objective: Measured at 5b25c3c9: chartInApp is 'placed' for area only via src/registry/parameter-applier.ts:63-77 (a MarkArea trait bound with a `chart` parameter projects VizAreaPreview into the detail view extension with a fixed title); VizHeatmapPreview, VizLinePreview, VizMarkPreview, VizPointPreview and VizScatterPreview exist in React and Vue (packages/components-react/src/viz-recipes.tsx and the Vue package, measured 109/109 in the component ledger); no other Mark trait has a placement rule; the HTML renderer maps VizAreaPreview (render/component-map.ts:1563) and codegen binds its props (codegen/binding-utils.ts:1171); no viz mutation bite exists; #1442's optional echarts-render-soak heap-slope failure reproduces on unchanged controls (learning #561) and has never been investigated. Build, per settled decision 6: (1) generalise the placement rule: any Mark* trait bound with a `chart` parameter projects its preview recipe (MarkLine → VizLinePreview, MarkBar → VizMarkPreview or a bar preview, MarkPoint → VizPointPreview, MarkHeatmap → VizHeatmapPreview, and one ECharts family through a new preview recipe born on the Sprint 192 proof loops with HTML, React, Vue, a11y and theme cells) into the detail view extension and the dashboard context where the object has one, with title and description from the trait parameters, through the same parameter-applier path area uses; (2) at least bar, line and one ECharts family are placed on public objects whose traits declare suitable data, chosen from the trait declarations and recorded with the reason; generated React/Vue/HTML carry real renderer SVG (never a placeholder); the composition census enumerates the objects that gained a chart as a movement class; runtime cells are re-swept (154 plus any new cells, one pack) with a11y/theme cells for the new placements; every other type records not-placed with a reason in the census; (3) three viz bites, each red→green with receipts: the palette bake removed → certify contrast fail and the viz census red; a registry row hand-edited → the contract test red; the m03 pattern sha changed → red; restored after each; (4) #1442: reproduce the soak on the head and on the unchanged control, record the heap slope and the allocation site if found, fix the cause if it fits the mission, otherwise narrow the job to a typed observation in its summary; no threshold change without a measured cause; (5) receipts under artifacts/product-reality/sprint-195/m06/. Descope rung: the ECharts placement may carry with the reason; bar and line never. No hand-edited composed schema.

decisions.decision: The physical palette-bake bite exposed a false contrast exemption. Compiled nominal/ordinal color without its baked range now fails contrast and makes conformant false; continuous/default-gradient and decorative/no-color exemptions remain unchanged. This structural failure reports measured:false and evidence:none even if determinism independently renders an SVG; a measured passing layer cannot relabel a missing-palette winning failure as measured. Preserve per-unit notes and strip the internal measurement marker from public output. Evidence: m06/bites/attempt-2/palette and the final palette rerun under m06/bites/attempt-3, plus four actual-AJV boundary/control receipts in artifacts/product-reality/sprint-195/m06/certify-measurement/boundary.
